purpose: Quantify how much official OCF varies when only the per-row weighting of identical scores changes. Experiment 78 showed one monotone rescaling moves fold-4 OCF by 0.14-0.24; this measures the full band so future single-run comparisons have a calibrated floor.

protocol.model: base Task 3 50 ms MLP, fold 4, seed 42, identical to experiment 78
protocol.perturbation: for each row independently multiply the scores by a positive factor drawn from U(0.5, 2.0); the within-row ordering is unchanged, only the relative weight of rows in the Hungarian objective changes
protocol.canonical: row-z scores as the reference value
protocol.metric: official OCF on RNG123 heldout pictures [256:768], Hungarian per 2748-trial session block

report: per-mouse mean, standard deviation, min, max, p05, p95
prohibited: using the band to select a favourable scaling
